newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures finish mostly lower.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures finish mostly lower.

text.p: July 1 - IMM currency futures closed mostly lower. Sept marks retreated from gains which were set on weaker-than-expected U.S. June NAPM and May construction spending data. Sept Swiss francs edged closer to the four-mos low of $0.6868. U.S. adj retail sales rose 1.7 pct in the four weeks of fiscal June vs May. ((Chicago Derivatives Desk (312)408-8750))
